Selected work

AI & CLOUD OPERATIONS

Lemma

Making cloud deployment a conversation.

An AI operations platform that turns natural-language requests into infrastructure and application deployments, with human approval before consequential actions.

  • Isolated AWS accounts for each workspace, provisioned by a queue-driven worker.
  • A ZIP-to-live-URL pipeline using CodeBuild and Fargate.
  • Deterministic, tested tools for provisioning, deploying, and teardown.
PythonNext.jsAWSClaude

Visit Lemma (opens in a new tab)

Inside the build

A FastAPI and SQLAlchemy backend coordinates queue-driven provisioning, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. The frontend uses Next.js and TypeScript.

Images build inside the customer’s AWS account. Applications run on Fargate behind a shared ALB per workspace. Resources are provisioned lazily to keep idle infrastructure costs near zero.

A Claude-powered agent calls deterministic tools; consequential actions require a person’s approval. Provisioning has moto-mocked unit tests and gated integration tests against AWS.

PLATFORM ENGINEERING

eksp

Infrastructure with the hard parts considered.

A Terraform-provisioned EKS platform with autoscaling, secure service networking, GitOps delivery, and observability built into its foundations.

  • Karpenter and request-based autoscaling for cost-efficient capacity.
  • Istio ambient mesh with strict mTLS and authorization policies.
  • SLO dashboards, burn-rate alerts, and a custom FinOps app.

The platform is designed for one million requests per minute sustained, with 3× spike absorption. These design targets are encoded as k6 load thresholds mapped to SLOs.

TerraformKubernetesArgoCDGo
Inside the build

The k6 suite defines smoke, ramp, spike, and soak thresholds. The throughput figures are design targets rather than measured production traffic.

Karpenter uses spot-first NodePools with on-demand fallback. ArgoCD handles app-of-apps delivery, sync waves, and environment promotion. Istio enforces strict mTLS, authorization policies, and L7 waypoint policy.

Security includes OIDC-only CI, EKS Pod Identity, restricted Pod Security Standards, default-deny networking, and KMS-encrypted secrets. Eighteen architecture decision records document the choices. costwatch, a Go and React app, tracks hourly AWS spend using Cost Explorer.
